grounding.from: Ratehub lists the best high-ratio (insured) 5-year fixed rate in Canada at 4.34%.

grounding.states: lowest uninsured (conventional) 5-year fixed is 4.44%, with Wowa's figures not fully consistent
grounding.from: Wowa puts the lowest conventional (uninsurable) 5-year fixed rate at 4.44%. That is a different figure from Wowa's own later line quoting 4.64% for uninsurable mortgages, so its numbers don't agree with each other.

grounding.states: a Big 6 bank's 5-year fixed is 4.54%, and Scotiabank's is 4.74%
grounding.from: Ratehub's table (updated October 13) shows a Big 6 bank at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%.

grounding.states: rates are climbing since early September
grounding.from: Rates are climbing in October 2026, after all six of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September.

value.answer: Lowest 5-year fixed I can see right now is about 4.34% if the mortgage is insured (under 20% down), per Ratehub and Wowa. Uninsured, Wowa has the lowest at 4.44%, but its own numbers don't fully agree, so take that one with a grain of salt. The big banks are higher: 4.54% at the lowest of them on Ratehub's table, Scotiabank at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September, so they're moving up, not down.
